author: Shelly Womack
title: Abilene Trophy recognizes Tampa Bay community's support of military families - NewsBreak
text:
By Shelly Womack No media credit provided. ,
2 hours ago
ABILENE, Texas ( KTAB/KRBC ) – Texas AMC Civic Leader and KTAB Meteorologist Sam Nichols had the honor of presenting the prestigious Abilene Trophy on Wednesday night in Tampa, Florida.
Abilene Trophy awarded to Tampa Bay community for outstanding military support The Abilene Trophy recognizes outstanding community support for Air Mobility Command (AMC) and Air Force Reserve Command (AFRC) units across the nation. This year’s award was presented to the Tampa Bay area, where MacDill Air Force Base is located, for its exceptional commitment to military members and their families.
Before 1999, Abilene frequently received the Strategic Air Command and Air Combat Command Community Support Awards so often that the honor was ultimately retired. That same year, AMC and the Abilene Military Affairs Council established a new national recognition, originally called the AMC Community Support Award, which later became known as the Abilene Trophy.
Nichols, who has served as an honorary commander at Dyess Air Force Base for more than 20 years, presented the award alongside Abilene resident and Texas AMC Civic Leader Paul Beale.
“It just represents the long-term commitment between the communities in the Greater Tampa area to deliver continuous support to meet the needs of the wing and area military families,” Nichols said to the crowd. “The air fest, the educational initiatives, the workforce programs and the unprecedented community response following hurricanes Helene and Milton, the service restock program, it was a rapid response to help restore stability for over 400 military families desperate for hope, the Christmas morning 2024 event that just gets me kind of emotional.”
The Abilene Military Affairs Council, in partnership with AMC and AFRC, oversees the nationwide competition each year. Communities supporting nearby AMC or AFRC bases submit nomination packages in early summer, which are reviewed by a selection committee. Final recommendations are then forwarded to command leadership ahead of the annual Airlift/Tanker Association convention.
